verdict.rationale: Chargebee's dunning sends email reminders asking customers to update their payment details. Its hosted pages are documented as a PCI-friendly way to handle card payment methods, which implies a hosted path for customers to update cards, but no evidence shows cards updating themselves. Missing for 10: network/card account updater, backup or secondary payment method fallback, explicit hosted update-payment-method page documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
